question: Honey is composed of water and two types of sugars: ______ and glucose.
solution:
The correct answer is __**fructose.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Honey **is composed primarily of** water **and two sugars: **fructose and glucose**.
 
• **Enzymes, amino acids, B vitamins, vitamin C, minerals, and antioxidants** are also present in trace levels.
 
• A large portion of the antioxidants in honey are **flavonoids**.
 
• **The anti-inflammatory characteristic**s of flavonoids suggest they may offer some **health advantages.**
 
• **Fructose:**
 
 
• Fructose is a type of sugar known as a **monosaccharide.**
 
• Along with **glucose and some traces of galactose**, it is one of the three dietary monosaccharides that are** directly absorbed** into the blood following **digestion.**
 
• Because it is largely found naturally in many** fruits,** fructose is also referred to as** "fruit sugar."**
 
• It also naturally occurs in other plant-based foods like **vegetables, honey, sugar beets, and sugar cane.****​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sucrose:**

 
 
• **Disaccharide sugar sucrose** is made up of the **subunits of glucose and fructose.**

 
 
• It is the** primary ingredient of white suga**r and is naturally generated by** plants.**
 
 
 
• Its chemical formula is **C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁.**
 
 
 
• **Dextrose:**
 
 
• A form of sugar called dextrose typically comes from** corn or wheat**.
 
• Dextrose is almost** identical to glucose**, which is the sugar found in the bloodstream.
 
 
 
• **Laevulose:**
 
 
• Laevulose is a** water-soluble white crystalline sugar **found in honey and a variety of fruits.
